title: The Great Emu War
subject: The Great Emu War, Western Australia, November to December 1932: soldiers of the Royal Australian Artillery under Major Meredith, with two Lewis guns, are sent to cull about 20,000 emus damaging wheat farms in the Campion district, and the emus mostly win
angle: the official reports, the numbers and the newspapers: a real military operation that lost to birds
notes: Slate film (films/director/SLATE.md), Sam's order of 22 Oct 2026: new stories through our process, free tools only. Dry, true, a little absurd; the documents and numbers carry the humour. No graphic harm to animals: numbers only.
